rv.q: 'Memorabilia' is still a very rewarding and unusual show and a piece of new work with formidable potential.
It is hilarious, it is touching, it is memorable. This is a perfect show to bring the whole family to. In fact, part of the joy is watching others experience it with you. Go see it.
Frantic, funny and lively enough for all ages—but deep enough for adults—'Memorabilia' is a fun departure from standard theatrical fare.
Jean Claudio's solo work Memorabilia now on view at Filament Theatre is a triumph of physical performance art.
